items.content_html: Next.js applications that set cookies through NextResponse on Edge runtime routes — App Router route handlers and Pages Router Edge API routes — send an internal x-middleware-set-cookie header in the public response, duplicating the cookie value and its attributes. This makes HttpOnly cookies, such as session tokens, readable by JavaScript running on the same origin when an application sets a sensitive cookie on an affected response.Referenceshttps://github.com/vercel/next.js/security/advisories

items.content_html: On self-hosted deployments, the Next.js image optimizer (/_next/image) can be made to process an attacker-supplied SVG even when SVG support is disabled with dangerouslyAllowSVG: false (the default).
